diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all four rollouts because the lone decision-maker used the public facts S2 and S3, which were always set to 'true' and 'false', respectively. These values did not change and were sufficient to satisfy the condition for C3, which likely required a boolean value to be true. Since S2 and S3 were always accessible and correct, the check C3 could be satisfied without needing the hidden information provided by PF1 and PF2.

C3.why: The network memo changes the minimum age to exactly 13, limits each verified account to one vote, and fixes the closing time at exactly 9:50 PM Eastern.
The certification result changes the voting channel from SMS-or-web to a portal-only channel and makes account verification a required technical step.
